title: Little Penguin, Snow Much Fun!
alt: A little penguin in a pastel striped scarf waves on the snow.
caption: A little snowy adventure.

title: Step, step. Here we go!
alt: Little Penguin lifts one foot and leaves four footprints in soft snow.
feedback: Little steps in the soft, soft snow.

title: A snowflake! Hello, snow!
cue: Tap the snowflake. Can you catch it?
alt: Little Penguin holds out a flipper beneath a falling snowflake.

title: Roll, roll. Here we go!
alt: Little Penguin pushes a white snowball with both flippers.

title: Pat, pat. A snow penguin!
cue: Tap the snow penguin. Say hello!
action: Say hello to the snow penguin
alt: Little Penguin stands beside a small two-ball snow penguin with a carrot beak and twig flippers.

title: Slide, slide. Here we go!
alt: Little Penguin slides on its belly over a low snow mound, feet trailing behind.

title: Flap, flap. A snow angel!
alt: Little Penguin lies on its back with flippers spread in a pale blue snow-angel impression.
feedback: Flippers out. Flippers in. Flap, flap!

title: Brush, brush. Off goes the snow!
cue: Tap the snowy tummy. Brush, brush!
alt: Little Penguin brushes loose snow from its tummy with one flipper.

title: Bye-bye, snow! Step, step. Home we go!
cue: Tap a flipper to wave goodbye.
alt: Little Penguin waves beside its snow penguin, with footprints leading away.
feedback: Bye-bye, snowy friend. Snow much fun!
